title: "Calculate lipid concentration and flux from traits"
author: "Patrick Pata"
date: "2025-11-27"
output: html_document
---


This file replaces parts of a few deprecated files including UPV6_carbon_export.Rmd and UVP_lipidscape_analysis.Rmd.


Tarling et al. (2022) method for carbon export
1. The total respiration flux is the summation of the product of abundance * diapause duration * respiration rate at each depth layer
2. Overwintering non-predatory mortality rate (beta) = -0.001 day-1
3. The total flux of the stored lipid and structural carbon from overwintering mortality is the fraction of the abundance lost to natural mortality multiplied by either the stored lipid or structural lipid carbon mass.
4. The total C flux is the sum of the total respiration flux + total stored lipid mortality flux + structural carbon mortality flux (ug C m-2 year-1)

The version of this here (need to verify):
1. At each depth bin, calculate the total diapause respiration rate (ug C m-2) by multiplying the depth of the bin layer (5 m) * total of (individual respiration rate ug C s-1) / volume filtered in the depth layer (m-3) * diapause duration (days)
2. Calculate proportion of the assemblage subjected to overwintering mortality at each depth bin. Based on total abundance of the depth bin? Or the abundance represented by each individual and then sum all individuals?

Visser et al. (2017) uses the mortality rate of 0.005 d-1. (higher mortality, stronger lipid pump)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# 1. Prepare dataframe of sampled volumes
```{r}
volumes.df <- all.copepods.uvp6 %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) 
# Note that the volumes are totaled here (i.e., not averaging the 5m bin vlaues)
binsize <- 100
# Set the depthBinLabel factors ... applied to Ecopart volume!
dbs <- volumes.df %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  
  # TODO Alternative depth bins... 0-50, 50-100, 100:500, 500-1000, 1000+ ??
  
  # Calculate volumes
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  
  # Add labels for the depth bins
  mutate(depthBinLabel = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  # arbitrary assignment of layers
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin >= 200 & depthBin < 500,
                         "mesopelagic", "sequestration")) %>% 
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin < 200, "epipelagic", layer))
```


# 2. Calculate the total carbon to be exported by each individual
This is the finest resolution for the data since the volume information is in 5m bins. There are about 1.7 segmented images (1-28 range) per 5m bin and about 9 images (1-96) per 100 m bins.
```{r}
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

cope_carbon_5m <- indiv_traits %>% 
  
  # Add column of the volume sampled in 5m depth bins
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max/5)*5 + 2.5 ) %>% 
  left_join(volumes.df, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 

  # Calculate abundance fraction represented by the individual (indivs m-2) in 5m bins
  mutate(abund_frac_5m = (5*(1/Sampled_volume_m3))) %>%  

  # Calculate the respired carbon concentration (m-2) of each individual
  # abundance in indivs m-2 * total C respired by the individual
  mutate(tot_c_resp = abund_frac_5m * diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC ) %>% 
  # Calculate the fraction of the abundance fraction subjected to overwintering non-predatory mortality (indivs m-2)
  mutate(mort_frac = abund_frac_5m - 
           (abund_frac_5m * exp(beta * diapauseDuration_day))) %>% 
  # Calculate the structural carbon and lipid carbon loss to natural mortality (ug C m-2)
  mutate(tot_c_struc_mort = mort_frac * structural_carbon_mgC * 1000,
         tot_c_lipid_mort = mort_frac * waxester_mass_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  # Calculate the total carbon flux contribution of the 5m depth bin (ug C m-2 year-1)
  mutate(tot_c_flux = tot_c_resp + tot_c_struc_mort + tot_c_lipid_mort)

# # How many segmented images in 5m bins / 100m bins?
# cope_carbon_5m %>% 
#   filter(object_annotation_category %notin% 
#            c("Calanoida", "Copepoda<Maxillopoda")) %>% 
#   # group_by(sample_id, Depth_5m) %>% 
#   mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m/100)*100) %>% 
#   group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
#   summarise(nind = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
#   select(nind) %>% 
#   summary()

# Total values in 5m bins. This is the minimum value given that volume is in 5m bins. All values are concentration by area (m2) for a 5m water parcel, except of lipid fullness which is the average. To get the concentration by volume (m3), divide by 5m.
profile_totals_5m <- cope_carbon_5m %>% 
  # Only consider all calanus spp, regardless of source
  filter(source %in% c("RF Calanus spp", "CNN segmentation",
                       "Manual segmentation")) %>% 
  # integrate to 5m bins
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Site, Cruise, sample_id,
           Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3, temp_depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m),
            biomass_gC_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m * prosome_total_mgC) / 1000,
            lipid_gC_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m * waxester_mass_mgC) / 1000,
            tot_c_flux_gC_m2y_5m = sum(tot_c_flux) / 1000 / 1000,
            total_c_resp_gC_m2y_5m = sum(tot_c_resp) / 1000 / 1000,
            total_c_struc_mort_gC_m2y_5m = sum(tot_c_struc_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            tot_c_lipid_mort_gC_m2y_5m = sum(tot_c_lipid_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            
            lipid_full_mean_5m = mean(lipid_fullness),
            nimages = n(),
            .groups = "drop")


# Calculate profile group centroids
pg_meta <- uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
  mutate(ctd_maxdep = if_else(is.na(ctd_maxdep), ctd_maxpres, ctd_maxdep)) %>% 
  group_by(Cruise, region, profile_group) %>% 
  summarise(longitude = mean(uvp6_longitude),
            latitude = mean(uvp6_latitude),
            date = mean(uvp6_date),
            max_ctd_depth = max(ctd_maxdep),
            mean_ctd_depth = mean(ctd_maxdep),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(region_rename, by = "region") %>% 
  arrange(region.inuktitut, latitude) %>% 
  filter(profile_group %in% profile_totals_5m$profile_group) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  mutate(total_profiles = sum(nprofiles)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Number of profiles and profile groups by region
pg_meta %>% 
  group_by(region, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(n_profilegroups = n(),
            n_profiles = sum(nprofiles),
            .groups = "drop")

# Number of images in a profile/profile groups
AA <- profile_totals_5m %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group) %>% 
  summarise(totalimages = sum(nimages), .groups = "drop")

```

Note that this is coarse and does not integrate by profile group
```{r, eval=FALSE}
vert_profiles_100m_ave <- profile_totals_5m %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance_m2_5m/5,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_gC_m2_5m/5 * 1000,
         lipid_mgC_m3 = lipid_gC_m2_5m/5 * 1000) %>%
  # average by 100m bins
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Site, Cruise, sample_id,

  summarise(abundance_m3 = mean(abundance_m3),
            biomass_mgC_m3 = mean(biomass_mgC_m3),

  mutate(depthBinLabel = factor(temp_depth_bin,
```

# 3. Spatial Integrations
## V1: Calculate total abundance and biomass per profile and source of carbon
Integration option 1: Average by profile groups in 5m bins, then calculate depth integrations
```{r}
profile_group_aves_5m <- profile_totals_5m %>% 
  # rename columns
  rename(Abundance = abundance_m2_5m, Biomass = biomass_gC_m2_5m,
         Lipids = lipid_gC_m2_5m, Lipid_Fullness = lipid_full_mean_5m,
         Total_C_Flux = tot_c_flux_gC_m2y_5m,
         Diapause_Respiration = total_c_resp_gC_m2y_5m,
         Mortality_Lipid = tot_c_lipid_mort_gC_m2y_5m,
         Mortality_Structural = total_c_struc_mort_gC_m2y_5m) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = Sampled_volume_m3:nimages,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
  # average by profile group at each 5m bin
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Cruise, Depth_5m, variable) %>% 
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
            sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

#  integrate to entire profile (m-2)
profile_group_totals <- profile_group_aves_5m %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Cruise, variable) %>%
  summarise(sum_value = sum(mean_value),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # adjust lipid fullness to average
  mutate(mean_value = sum_value/n5mbins, sum_value)
  
regional_averages <- profile_group_totals %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, variable) %>% 
  summarise(region_mean = mean(sum_value),
            region_sd = sd(sum_value),
            npgs = n(), .groups = "drop")

 
clrs <- rev(c("blue","black","hotpink"))

# TODO Organize by region
ggplot(regional_averages %>% 
         filter(variable %in% c("Diapause_Respiration",
                                "Mortality_Lipid","Mortality_Structural")), 
       aes(x = region.inuktitut, y = region_mean, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  ylab("Lipid pump carbon flux (gC m-2 y-1)") + xlab("Region") +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev)

ggsave("figures/lipid_pump_mean_components_by_region.png",
       width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

# As box plot
ggplot(profile_group_totals %>% 
         filter(variable == "Total_C_Flux"),
       aes(y = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = sum_value, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  # Add average values for the region
  geom_point(data = regional_averages %>% 
         filter(variable == "Total_C_Flux"),
         aes(x = region_mean), shape = 17, size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_linerange(data = regional_averages %>% 
         filter(variable == "Total_C_Flux"),
         aes(xmin = region_mean - region_sd,
                    xmax = region_mean + region_sd),
                color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,14,2)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 15)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Lipid pump carbon flux (gC m-2 y-1)") + ylab("Region") 

ggsave("figures/lipid_pump_totals_by_region.png",
       width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

# Abundance and biomass
ggplot(profile_group_totals %>% 
         filter(variable == "Abundance"),
       aes(y = region.inuktitut, x = sum_value)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = region.inuktitut)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Abundance (indiv m-2)") + ylab("Region") 
```

## V2: Integrate to 100 m bins first
Note that the last bins are not averaged properly since sampled depths can vary a lot
```{r}
profile_group_aves_100m <- profile_totals_5m %>% 
  # rename columns
  rename(Abundance = abundance_m2_5m, Biomass = biomass_gC_m2_5m,
         Lipids = lipid_gC_m2_5m, Lipid_Fullness = lipid_full_mean_5m,
         Total_C_Flux = tot_c_flux_gC_m2y_5m,
         Diapause_Respiration = total_c_resp_gC_m2y_5m,
         Mortality_Lipid = tot_c_lipid_mort_gC_m2y_5m,
         Mortality_Structural = total_c_struc_mort_gC_m2y_5m) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Sampled_volume_m3, Abundance:Mortality_Lipid),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
  # Integrate to 100m bins per sample
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, sample_id,
           Cruise, temp_depth_bin, variable) %>% 
  summarise(value_100m_sum = sum(value, na.rm = T),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # average by profile group at each 100m bin

  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Cruise, temp_depth_bin, variable) %>% 
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value_100m_sum, na.rm = T),
            mean_n5mbins = mean(n5mbins),
            nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

#  integrate to entire profile (m-2)
profile_group_totals_v2 <- profile_group_aves_100m %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Cruise, variable) %>%
  summarise(sum_value = sum(mean_value),
            n100mbins = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
regional_averages_v2 <- profile_group_totals_v2 %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, variable) %>% 
  summarise(region_mean = mean(sum_value),
            region_sd = sd(sum_value),
            npgs = n(), .groups = "drop")




ggplot(regional_averages_v2 %>% 
         filter(variable %in% c("Diapause_Respiration",
                                "Mortality_Lipid","Mortality_Structural")),

  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +

  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +

# As box plot
```

# 4. Vertical biomass profiles
This uses the option 1 integration of averaging 5m intervals per profile group first, then summing over 100 m depth bins, then plot regional averages.
Also separate Calanus spp vs Likely Copepoda > 3mm
```{r}
biomass_vert_100m <- cope_carbon_5m %>% 
  # Differentiate Calanus spp segmented images and large copepods
  mutate(source2 = if_else(source %in% c("RF Calanus spp", "CNN segmentation",
                       "Manual segmentation"), 
                       "Calanus spp","Copepoda > 3mm") ) %>% 
  # integrate to 5m bins
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Site, Cruise, sample_id,
           Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3, 
           temp_depth_bin, source2) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m),
            biomass_gC_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m * prosome_total_mgC) / 1000,
            lipid_gC_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m * waxester_mass_mgC) / 1000,
            lipid_full_mean_5m = mean(lipid_fullness),
            nimages = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 

  # average by profile group at each 5m bin
  rename(Abundance = abundance_m2_5m, Biomass = biomass_gC_m2_5m,
         Lipids = lipid_gC_m2_5m, Lipid_Fullness = lipid_full_mean_5m) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = Abundance:Lipid_Fullness,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Cruise, Depth_5m, variable,
           temp_depth_bin, source2) %>% 
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = T),
            sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 

  # integrate to concentrations in 100 m bins both (m2 and m3)
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Cruise, variable,
           temp_depth_bin, source2) %>% 
  summarise(value_total_m2 = sum(mean_value),
            value_mean_m3 = mean(mean_value/5),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  
  # Adjust depth bin point to 50m midpoints
  mutate(temp_depth_bin = temp_depth_bin + 50) %>% 
  mutate(depthBinLabel = factor(temp_depth_bin+50, 
                                   levels = seq(0,2500,100)))


biomass_vert_region <- biomass_vert_100m %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, variable, temp_depth_bin, source2) %>% 
  summarise(region_mean_total_m2 = mean(value_total_m2),
            region_sd_total_m2  = sd(value_total_m2),
            region_mean_mean_m3 = mean(value_mean_m3),
            region_sd_mean_m3  = sd(value_mean_m3),
            npgs = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(biomass_vert_region %>% 
         filter(variable == "Biomass"),

  geom_line() +

  scale_x_reverse(breaks = seq(0,2600,200)) +

                     name = "Region") +
```

## Check source fraction of total abundance, biomass and C flux per sample

```{r, eval=FALSE}
source_check <- cope_carbon_5m %>% 
  mutate(source = if_else(source %in% c("RF Calanus spp", "CNN segmentation", 
                                        "Manual segmentation"),
                          "Calanus spp", source)) %>% 
  # integrate to 5m bins
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Site, Cruise, sample_id,
           source, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m),
            biomass_gC_m2_5m = sum(abund_frac_5m * prosome_total_mgC) / 1000,
            tot_c_flux_gC_m2y_5m = sum(tot_c_flux) / 1000 / 1000,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
   group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, Site, Cruise, sample_id,
           source) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2_5m),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2_5m),
            tot_c_flux_gC_m2y = sum(tot_c_flux_gC_m2y_5m),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, source) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2 = mean(abundance_m2),
            biomass_gC_m2 = mean(biomass_gC_m2),
            tot_c_flux_gC_m2y = mean(tot_c_flux_gC_m2y),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(source = fct_rev(source))

  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs.source) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  # xlab("Stations ordered by cast depth") +

# average % of total abundance and biomass potentially from likely Calanus spp
source_check_perc <- source_check %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(abundance_m2, biomass_gC_m2, tot_c_flux_gC_m2y),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, profile_group, variable) %>% 
  mutate(total = sum(value)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(percent = value / total * 100) %>% 
  # Get average percentage of each variable
  group_by(source, variable) %>% 
  summarise(mean_perc = mean(percent, na.rm = T),
            sd_perc = sd(percent, na.rm = T),
            min_perc = min(percent, na.rm = T),
            max_perc = max(percent, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(variable)
```

# TEMP: 2Delete Open list of profile_groups and regions
```{r, eval=FALSE}
profiles_list <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "ECOPART_summary") %>% 
  rename(sample_id = Profile) %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, profile_group, region, cruise_name)

# Establish the depth bins and calculate total volume per bin
binsize <- 100
# These are depth bins of the profile_groups (i.e., multiple sample grouped as one big profile)
dbs.pgs <- all.copepods.uvp6 %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>%
  left_join(profiles_list, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  # Calculate volumes
  group_by(profile_group, region, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3, na.rm = T),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Add labels for the depth bins
  mutate(depthBinLabel = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  # arbitrary assignment of layers
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin >= 200 & depthBin < 500,
                         "mesopelagic", "sequestration")) %>% 
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin < 200, "epipelagic", layer))

cope_carbon_100m.pgs <- cope_carbon %>% 
  # add profile_group and region information
  
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  # Add total volume per depth bin
  left_join(dbs.pgs, by = join_by(profile_group, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate abundance and carbon concentrations per 5 m depth bin
  group_by(profile_group, Cruise, depthBin, volume_m3, n5mbins,
           depthBinLabel, layer) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            total_carbon = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
            lipid_carbon = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
            lipid_fullness_mean = mean(lipid_fullness),
            diapause_respiration_mean = mean(respirationRate_ugCday),
            diapause_duration_mean = mean(diapauseDuration_day), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3,
         lipid_carbon_m3 = lipid_carbon / volume_m3,
         # This should practically be lipid_fullness_mean
         percent_lipid_total_carbon = lipid_carbon / total_carbon * 100) %>% 
  
  # lengthen data frame
  pivot_longer(cols = abundance:percent_lipid_total_carbon,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")


# The cope_carbon by station at profile group level
cope_carbon_100m.samps.grouped <- cope_carbon_100m %>% 
  
  # lengthen data frame
  pivot_longer(cols = abundance:percent_lipid_total_carbon,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(profiles_list, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  # average profiles in a profile group
  group_by(profile_group, region, depthBin, Cruise, 
           depthBinLabel, layer, variable) %>% 
  summarise(volume_mean = mean(volume_m3, na.rm = T),
            volume_total = sum(volume_m3, na.rm = T),
            value_mean = mean(value, na.rm = T),
            value_sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

# Compare the profile_group summation values VS the mean of profiles values
pgs.comparison <- cope_carbon_100m.pgs %>% 
  left_join(cope_carbon_100m.samps.grouped,
            join_by(profile_group, Cruise, depthBin, 
                    depthBinLabel, layer, variable)) %>% 
  filter(variable %in% c("abundance_m3","lipid_carbon_m3","total_carbon_m3"))

ggplot(pgs.comparison, aes(x = volume_m3, y = volume_total)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  xlab("Profile group sums") + ylab("Mean of profiles in a group") +
  ggtitle("Volumes (m3)")

ggplot(pgs.comparison, aes(x = value, y = value_mean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  facet_wrap(~variable) +
  xlab("Profile group sums") + ylab("Mean of profiles in a group")
```

```{r}
mean(carbexp_tarling_samples.pgs$tot_c_flux)

region_rename <- data.frame(
  region = c("Baffin Bay", "Baffin Shelf", 
             "Davis Strait", "Lancaster Sound",
             "North Water Polynya", "Labrador Shelf", 
             "Greenland Shelf", "Nares Strait"),
  region.inuktitut = c("Sannirutiup Imavik\n(Baffin Bay)", 
                       "Qikiqtaaluk Shelf\n(Baffin Shelf)",
                       "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)", 
                       "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)",
                       "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)", 
                       "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)",
                       "Kalaallit Nunaat Shelf\n(Greenland Shelf)", 
                       "Sarvarjuaq\n(Nares Strait)"),
  region.color = c("goldenrod2","purple2","turquoise2","forestgreen",
                   "deeppink1","red","blue1", "sienna2"))




# Regional averages of the profile_groups
regional_totals <- carbexp_tarling_samples.pgs %>% 
  distinct(region, profile_group, tot_c_flux, biomass, abundance) %>% 
  # Calculate means here to organize levels
  group_by(region) %>% 
  mutate(mean_tot_c_flux = mean(tot_c_flux),
         sd_tot_c_flux = sd(tot_c_flux),
         mean_biomass = mean(biomass),
         sd_biomass= mean(biomass),
         mean_abundance = mean(abundance),
         sd_abundance = sd(abundance),
         n_pgs = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(mean_tot_c_flux) %>% 
  left_join(region_rename)
regional_totals <- regional_totals %>% 
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = unique(regional_totals$region))) %>% 
  mutate(region.inuktitut = factor(region.inuktitut, 
                                   levels = unique(regional_totals$region.inuktitut))) %>% 
  mutate(region.color = factor(region.color, levels = unique(regional_totals$region.color)))

ggplot(regional_totals ,
       aes(y = region.inuktitut, x = tot_c_flux)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = region.inuktitut)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = levels(regional_totals$region.color)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = mean_tot_c_flux), shape = 17, size = 3, color = "pink") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = mean_tot_c_flux - sd_tot_c_flux,
                    xmax = mean_tot_c_flux + sd_tot_c_flux),
                color = "pink", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Lipid pump carbon flux (gC m-2 y-1)") + ylab("Region")

# ggsave("figures/annual_lipid_pump_by_region.png",
#        width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

# TODO have the same regional plot but for depth-integrated copepod biomass
ggplot(regional_totals,
       aes(y = region.inuktitut, x = biomass)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = region.inuktitut)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = levels(regional_totals$region.color)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Biomass (gC m-2)") + ylab("Region")

ggplot(regional_totals,
       aes(y = region.inuktitut, x = abundance)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = region.inuktitut)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = levels(regional_totals$region.color)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("Abundance (indivs m-2)") + ylab("Region")
```

```{r}
carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  filter(sample_id == "am_leg2_tcad1b")


AA <- cope_carbon_100m %>% 
  filter(sample_id == "am_leg2_tcad1b") %>% 
  filter(variable %in% c("abundance_m3","total_carbon_m3")) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>% 
  mutate(value_integ = value * (5*n5mbins) ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, variable) %>% 
  summarise(value_integ_m2 = sum(value_integ),
            .groups = "drop")
```
